about: The week of the game's Sotavento world cup, after the real World Cup Fuerteventura 2026 (Slalom-X, men): its race days and the eliminations sailed on each, read from the streams' commentary on 27 November 2026 (tools/broadcast/format_facts.py): eliminations 1 and 2 on 22 July, 3 and 4 on the 23rd, 5 to 7 on the 24th, 8 and 9 on the 25th, 10 and 11 on the 26th. In the game every elimination is a normal slalom elimination (the real week had full-fleet races and an obstacle among them). Each day's wind is what the commentator and the sailors said on the stream that day ('wind' gives the words): an estimate, not a measurement; the direction is the spot's trade wind. NOT USED YET: the live week sails every heat in the wind the game was started with (--wind).
name: VWA World Cup Sotavento
